description: This file declares functions for interfacing with an HD44780 LCD, including initialization, cursor positioning, character and string printing, getting current cursor position, and displaying a panic message.

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_init
methods.description: Initializes the HD44780 LCD with shared logger

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_set_position
methods.description: Sets the cursor position on the LCD

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_char
methods.description: Prints a single character to the LCD

methods.name: lcd_HD44780_print_string
methods.description: Prints a null-terminated string to the LCD

methods.name: getCurrentHD44780row
methods.description: Returns the current row of the cursor

methods.name: getCurrentHD44780column
methods.description: Returns the current column of the cursor

methods.name: lcdShowPanicMessage
methods.description: Displays a panic message on the LCD
